solution:
** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] __Additional Information__**

Please read the question carefully. In the table, __**the percentage of marks obtained by 5 students in different subjects" is given, not the absolute marks.**__

Calculation:

Maximum marks in English = 200

Marks obtained by Sushil in English is = 75% of 200 = 150

Marks obtained by Shyamu in English is 65% of 200 = 130

So difference = 150 - 130 = 20

∴ Option 3 is the correct answer.
